notes: Entries, names and numbers are exactly as printed on NEA pages (English page /en/, Nepali page /np/). Numbers in the Nepali page are the same numbers written in Devanagari digits; tel: hrefs are identical on both pages.
province_en/province_np = the NEA provincial/division office list the entry is published under (NEA administrative grouping, not necessarily the geographic province of the place).
name_np is null where the Nepali page prints the name in Latin script (no official Nepali name published); name_np_as_printed keeps the Nepali-page text verbatim.
dial = digits of the printed number with dashes/spaces removed (for tel: links). No area codes were added.
nea_site_footer_last_updated is the site-wide footer value on the English pages, not a directory-specific date. The Nepali pages show no last-updated date.
No national/short-code line (e.g. 1150) is shown on the NEA No Light pages.
